sub_function: Legal sponsor of record, exclusive legal control, board governance, variance power
minimum_viable_requirement: A 170(c) non-private-foundation organization that owns and controls the fund; contemporaneous written acknowledgment of exclusive legal control to donors
regulatory_or_control_anchor: IRC 4966(d)(1)-(2); IRC 170(f)(18); Form 990 Schedule D Part I line 5
decision_rationale: Entrant is a technology provider; forming a captive sponsor creates related-party/independence questions (RCF-Ren 98% fee share is the in-repo precedent) and years of governance build
candidate_providers: Endaoment (partner API, sponsor of record); GiveClear Foundation (sponsor for TIFIN Give/SEI); Charityvest (independent sponsor, FS-powered); NPT private label; RCF white label; AEF; Fidelity Charitable CIAP (advisor-managed accounts only); NCF
partner_fit_evidence_status: Endaoment=evidenced (public partner tiers); GiveClear=evidenced (TIFIN/SEI); Charityvest=evidenced (advisor/white-label program, FS software); NPT=evidenced (private label); RCF=evidenced (Ren white label, related party); AEF=evidenced as Ren-administered independent sponsor, fit for a new vendor hypothetical; Fidelity Charitable CIAP=evidenced for adviser-managed investing, as tech partner hypothetical; NCF=hypothetical
what_ai_cannot_remove: Sponsor board discretion, legal ownership, donor trust in the charitable brand
strategy_relevance: S1 critical; S2 indirect; S3 indirect (customer is the sponsor)

sub_function: State charitable registration and solicitation compliance
minimum_viable_requirement: Sponsor registered where it solicits; entrant assesses whether its marketing role makes it a professional solicitor or commercial co-venturer in any state
regulatory_or_control_anchor: State charitable solicitation statutes; NASCO Unified Registration Statement
decision_rationale: Registration attaches to the soliciting charity; entrant should contract so sponsor solicits and entrant does not hold or receive gifts
candidate_providers: Sponsor partner; registration services (e.g., compliance firms) - none evaluated
what_ai_cannot_remove: State-specific legal judgment; regulator relationships

sub_function: Qualified custody of contributed and invested assets
minimum_viable_requirement: Assets held in sponsor's name at bank/broker-dealer custodian; entrant never takes possession
regulatory_or_control_anchor: Investment Company Act 3(c)(10)(B) exemption for charitable pools (Philanthropy Protection Act 1995); custodian CIP 31 CFR 1023.220

candidate_providers: Altruist (self-clearing since 2023); Apex; Schwab; Fidelity; BNY Pershing; BridgeFT (multi-custodial data via Foundation Source)

sub_function: Investment menu and adviser-managed accounts
